title: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) for Plus Members (18.75% for Non-Members) @ TopCashback UK
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) for Plus Members (18.75% for Non-Members) @ TopCashback UK

[despavr] The AU codes are not listed in the exceptions on TCB UK, will they still be okay to be used?
[Clear] Always always always always fine. Just make sure it's affiliated.
[PainToad] Hmmm only four always. I’m not convinced.
[toadbload] as another toad, i'm also not convinced, not enough always
[paaradiso] I'm very happy with my Fosi Audio BT20A MAX
[Clear] Ah I wasn't sure if regular members got 25% or not. Frustratingly even incognito it shows 25%.
[freelife] What's a Plus member? I don't see that option in Accounts?
Edit: never mind I see the option now to upgrade for £5 a year for the higher cashbacks. Only worth it if you're spending over AUD$100 or else the regular cashback with no member fee still pulls out ahead
[HomeAlone] £5 ≠ $5
$169+ spend for Plus to pull ahead.
[nategasm] $169+ over a year isn't too bad. But do note that in the past for the bigger sales they tend give Classic members the same rate as Plus (Maybe that'll change)
[YeemaiI] Website says this ends 22:59 tonight?
Also, any AliExpress cashback team?
[MiscOzB] I assume that's UK time, so just under 10 hours remaining.
[TerryTightwad] Wondering if its worth the upgrade to plus.
[Clear] For £5 a year taken out of your balance it'll certainly be worth it after a few big buys
https://www.topcashback.co.uk/classic-or-plus/
[TerryTightwad] Do they only have the upsized cashback for plus now? I didnt know about it.
[Clear] They've done it before previously. No idea of their future plans.
[TerryTightwad] @Clear: Would you also advise against using the shopping credit? Assuming thats inelligible for cashbacck, or atleast the portion not paid in cash.
[TerryTightwad] @Clear: So you definitely get cashback on the full amount if you use the teamozbargain shopping credit? Cos I assumed it would be exempt, or be minus the portion you used for shopping credit. Sorry to be annoying but I know you buy lots with these deals, and always avoided using it with cashback deals.
[harukane] Just a curiosity here.
I used a mobile this time to place an order. After logged into TopCashback UK, pressing "Get 25% Cashback" did open the AliExpress page from the browser, but then it redirected me to the app as I have AliExpress app installed. Would the purchase still be tracked?
Edit: nvm. It is tracked :p
[poppingtags] Hmm, anyone having issues with Paypal not giving you the option of bypassing their currency conversion? They've redesigned the Paypal checkout UI, and the option to select to bypass the currency conversion seems to have disappeared, and instead - it's card dependent. Revolut and Wise only have the option of paying in USD, all the other cards seem to be forced into using Paypal's conversion. If that's the case, I'll likely avoid them unless I have to.
[TerryTightwad] It always defaults to AUD but pretty sure the option is there, will have a look.
[ASR-Briggs] Picked up the Ananda Nanos for $324USD delivered and after tax (which HAS to be an ATL). Less 25%, that's $243USD!
[sillystickleback] Hi guys hope you can help with my concern:
I have my own Topcashback UK account and made an Aliexpress order in the past and it tracked within 10 minutes.
Today I invited my wife so both her and I can get the referral bonus. She then made a purchase in AliExpress using the same AliExpress account that I used to made my order in the past as mentioned above. And the order didn't track.
Questions:
- Was it not tracked because we used two different TCB accounts but same AliExpress credentials?
- If I need to submit a claim, which FX rate should I use to convert the purchase value to GBP as it was paid in AUD.
Thanks heaps!
[PostingMan] A non affiliated product I purchased with the other stuff tracked? Is that normal?
[nategasm] Yes that's normal, though it's unlikely to get paid out
